alt: AI-rendered futuristic Batman motorcycle in matte black and yellow with massive tires, low handlebars, and an angular front cowl that sits dangerously close to the front wheel
story: On October 22, 2026, HotCars analyzed an AI-generated Batman motorcycle concept by Instagram artist darkkuston; while it looks menacing, real riders immediately spot that the front wheel sits so close to the bodywork that any bump or hard braking would cause the tire to strike the cowl — catastrophic at speed.
why_funny: The Caped Crusader's imaginary engineers nailed the 'insane' brief but missed the part where the front wheel needs room to actually turn and absorb bumps.
